text.en: Spectrum: block size and window of the FFT behind each point.
text.cs: Spectrum: velikost bloku a okno FFT za každým bodem.

text.en: Band: F min and F max set the frequency band that is summed; Full Bandwidth goes up to Nyquist.
text.cs: Band: F min a F max určují sčítané frekvenční pásmo; Full Bandwidth jde až po Nyquista.

text.en: Tacho Tracking: RPM Tracked (axis in rpm) or Free Run (axis in time), Step, Sweep, Hysteresis.
text.cs: Tacho Tracking: RPM Tracked (osa v rpm) nebo Free Run (osa v čase), Step, Sweep, Hysteresis.

text.en: The curve: one point per step, the RMS of the whole band, against rpm or time.
text.cs: Křivka: jeden bod na krok, RMS celého pásma, podle rpm nebo času.
